In case you were wondering why the heck Mike Wang hasn't been updating the forum in recent times, there's a few things to clarify:
1) He didn't lose interest in Sarracenias
2) MW is still alive. In fact, he's still breathing as of 10/16/18.
3) He didn't find your comments offensive and isn't ignoring you on purpose.
4) He's been sleep deprived for weeks, and had a nasty cold at the same time.
5) He's still adjusting to juggling 2 kids and helping with the heavy lifting for the family.




That said, we just pulled an all nighter almost 2 weeks ago and Benny Wang was born Oct. 4th, 2018 at 4:06am! They always say, if the first child is chill, you can't expect the second child to be the same. Well, that's true, Benny turned out to be even more easy going than Ellie! When I told others how mellow Ellie is, they always said "well you just wait." Almost 4 years later, she's still mellow and easy going, but sassy and bossy haha!

I made a mistake and agreed with my wife that I'll handle Ellie and she gets Benny....starting to regret that, should have taken the gamble and gone for Benny, he's way easier LOL Anyways, here's Benny! He looks almost like a clone of Ellie when she was born:
